summary: Created expense-claims-validation skill capturing the document cross-validation workflow, fuzzy matching logic, and fraud detection patterns. Includes reusable Python script for parsing PDF claims against structured reference data with Levenshtein-based name matching and five validation checks (account, amount, employee existence, trip validity, traveler match). Addresses the brittle string similarity issue encountered with 'Briann Ortega' and documents the pdfplumber > PyPDF2 preference.
